iconPrompts.weapons: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI sprite atlas for Aberrant Frontier Echo Expedition, matching a sunny retrofuturist coastal expedition illustrated in clean angular cel-shaded anime key art. Disciplined big polygonal planes like carved painted resin, warm ivory lit faces, cool petroleum teal shadows, a little muted brass trim and precisely one vivid accent hue per subject. Warm directional light from upper left. Strong two-value silhouette, chunky graphic cuts, minimal interior marks, small-size first, mature field manual art direction. Real transparent background, isolated floating subjects with no backplate or border, no grid lines, no shadow outside subjects, absolutely no lettering or numerals. Exact regular equal cells, all centers precisely on the invisible mathematical grid, each subject fully contained at 75% of its cell span with generous uniform empty gutters. No touching edges or other cells. Left-to-right reading order. Layout: 3 columns by 2 rows of square cells, canvas aspect 3:2. one complete hero prop per cell, broad readable silhouette angled lower left to upper right. Top row: long gently curved charcoal single-edge sword with coral cutting edge, ivory guard and dark grip; long mint shaft spear with an ivory leaf-shaped point and split bone flanges; two short mirrored butterfly-wing crescent blades, lavender with brass hinges. Bottom row: chunky rectangular graphite sledgehammer with amber end caps, ivory dark handle; geometric ivory and jade crossbow with mint falcon-wing limbs and coral string; bulky violet and charcoal fictional crystal energy carbine with long barrel and chunky rear stock.
